id: title:TueHaulund:label unrecorded iframes and canvases in rendered replays

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated plugin and test coverage to the session replay system, introducing a new CSS marker and attribute to distinguish unrecorded content, and wiring this plugin into the replayer execution.
review.reason: The change implements a substantive, bounded capability: a new plugin and its associated tests are added to the session replay system. P1.F3.H1 introduces the plugin and its configuration, P1.F2.H2 wires it into the replayer, and P1.F1.H1 provides tests. This represents a clear, implemented feature rather than a narrow maintenance or documentation-only change.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit to PostHog users depends on the utility of distinguishing unrecorded content, which is not demonstrated by the code alone; the implementation and test coverage are visible, supporting a tier 2 assessment.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. P1.F4.H1 is a documentation-only update; P1.F3.H1, P1.F2.H2, P1.F1.H1 are the implementation and tests. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds a new plugin and its tests, P1.F3.H1, P1.F2.H2, P1.F1.H1. P1.F3.H1 introduces UnrecordedContentPlugin, UNRECORDED_STYLE_RULES, and scanRecordedContent. P1.F2.H2 wires the plugin into the replayer. P1.F1.H1 tests the plugin. P1.F4.H1 updates the AI prompt preamble.
observations.code_quote: background: ${labelImage(LABELS[kind])} center / min(440px, 100%) auto no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #f3f4f6 0 12px, #e5e7eb 12px 24px) !important;
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a CSS rule and an attribute marker to distinguish unrecorded iframes and canvases in the replay, preventing them from appearing as blank or failed content. This could help users distinguish between unrecorded and recorded content, and could help the AI distinguish between unrecorded and recorded content.
